status: rectangular design proposal; separate from accepted scene; not fabrication release
coordinateFrame: Casting-local XY, mm; heights relative to casting top

tray.installation: Install before upper machine assembly; assembled-machine removal unverified.
tray.rearMotorCover: No notch or separate cover in this proposal. Rectangular opening extends to casting rear edge; complete-machine clearance still to check.

sockets.reference: PFEIFER 05.250.064.040; M6 x 40; insertion dimension a=25, thread dimension e=6 mm
sockets.retentionGeometry: Nominal cylindrical socket and crimped/waved tail; outside diameter and tail dimensions assumed, not vendor CAD.

casting.backing: Reserve solid casting around anchors; current 4 mm ledges are superseded by top-level support in this proposal.
casting.seatChange: Seat at casting top, rather than a recessed floor. Tray underside +2 clears existing lifting-insert tops at 0.

screwSeatProposal.screw: ISO 4762 M6 x 25; head diameter 10, height 6 mm nominal
screwSeatProposal.compressionLoadPath: Head -> washer -> removable sleeve -> flush socket face; supported gasket carries sheet
screwSeatProposal.note: Insertion depth is not guaranteed threaded engagement. Supplier thread and screw compatibility still to confirm.

gasket.type: Single-sided adhesive closed-cell rubber gasket tape
gasket.status: unselected; verify grade compression force, recovery, coolant/oil and adhesive compatibility
gasket.installation: Adhesive on tray underside; screws provide compression. Continuous loop with sealed butt/scarf joint, no overlap. Screw holes outside wet seal where geometry permits.
gasket.compressionControl: Separate removable sleeves or stops, sized for installed stack after grade selection; no protruding cast-in sockets.
gasket.quantityBasis: Rectangular proposal v2: 7.0667 m net, plus 15% cutting allowance rounded up to 9 m.
gasket.note: Two rectangular loops. Rear inner return lies beyond casting and requires an underside support tied to frame; no raised-cover transition.
